new_acs: Contentstack Live Preview SDK is integrated into the metrolinx (next.metrolinx.com) Next.js app router application, enabling real-time preview of draft content entries in the CMS editor.

A Contentstack Live Preview configuration is added (live_preview hash, enable=true, host, and preview_token) so that editing a draft entry in Contentstack triggers a live preview refresh in the Next.js app.

Custom preview URLs are configured in Contentstack for at least one representative page template (e.g., a standard content page), so that the preview pane renders the draft entry using the app's rendering pipeline.
Draft content changes made in the Contentstack editor are reflected in the live preview pane within one revalidation cycle (no manual page refresh required by the author).
A known-limitation note is documented in the codebase (README or config comment) stating that protected/authenticated pages are excluded from live preview scope.
